revenueModel.text: Home buyers pay the company for delivered homes, and the company also earns revenue from land sales to joint ventures, third-party builders and other parties, plus ancillary services such as mortgage, title and golf operations.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, the company announced its exit from the multifamily development business, selling about half its Apartment Living portfolio and its operating platform to Kennedy Wilson.
changes.evidence: On September 18, 2025, we announced our intention to exit the multifamily development business, beginning with the sale of our interests in approximately half of our portfolio, as well as our operating platform, to Kennedy Wilson for a purchase price of approximately $380 million, as adjusted to reflect investments in certain assets since the September announcement.
